method: Arithmetic mean of each run sample mean; all raw sample values retained. Metrics with any incorrect sample are labeled correctnessQualified=false.

timingLimitations.candidate: Both runs use the same 240s correctness schedule and are descriptive only.
timingLimitations.complex: Both completed under the 60s support-discovery ceiling; values are descriptive and not timing-comparable to candidate.

comparability.reason: Complex runs used the 60-second support-discovery schedule; timings are descriptive and must not be compared to candidate timings.
